name.zh: 一辉与史黛菈遇见紫乃宫天音
name.en: Ikki and Stella meet Amane during a random-killer incident

periods.location: Yamagata shopping street and fast-food restaurant
periods.summary: Ikki detects a suspicious worker carrying a large knife and moves to stop him before a random stabbing. Amane Shinomiya intervenes first but has no real defensive plan; Ikki saves him by knocking the knife away and subduing the man. Amane introduces himself as a Kyoumon representative and Ikki super-fan, treats Ikki and Stella to fast food, asks for an autograph, and gushes over Ikki's famous lines. After Amane leaves, Ikki realizes that despite Amane's friendliness he feels no liking for him, only a sticky sense of omen.
periods.cause: Ikki and Stella jog into town after Stella's frustration over Toka; Amane's causality ability leads him into the incident ahead of Ikki.
periods.outcome: Ikki becomes wary of Amane, asks Kagami for information, and later connects Amane's timing to future prediction.
periods.significance: Introduces Amane's fan mask and plants the warning sign that later exposes Akatsuki's counter-trap.
